<a id="projectconf-upload-resetmethod"></a>

# `upload_resetmethod` {#upload-resetmethod}

- **Type:** String
- **Multiple values:** No

Specify reset method for "uploader" tool. This option isn't available for all development platforms. The only [Espressif 8266](/hardware/platforms/espressif8266) supports it.
